settings.title: Settings & Configuration
settings.subtitle: Manage factory profile, loom preferences, appearance, language, and account security.
settings.unsavedWarning: You have unsaved changes. Leaving will discard your edits.

factory.title: Factory Profile
factory.description: Configure factory contact details, location, and branding used on all sheets and reports.
factory.factoryCodeNote: Factory code is an immutable system identifier.
factory.logoHint: Recommended format: PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 1MB. Used on exported PDF/Excel sheets.

appearance.title: Appearance & Theme
appearance.description: Choose your preferred interface theme. Changes apply instantly and persist across sessions.
appearance.darkDesc: High-contrast dark mode tailored for factory shop-floor control rooms.
appearance.lightDesc: Crisp, bright daylight interface with maximum readability.
appearance.systemDesc: Automatically synchronizes with your device operating system theme.

language.title: Language & Localization
language.description: Select the display language for the factory interface. Changes apply immediately without logging out.
language.guDesc: ફેક્ટરી અને લૂમ ઓપરેશન માટે ગુજરાતી ભાષા
language.hiDesc: कारखाने और लूम संचालन के लिए हिन्दी भाषा

production.title: Loom & Shift Preferences
production.description: Configure standard shift hours, timings, and default efficiency calculation preferences.
production.shiftTotalNotice: Combined shift duration must equal 24 hours for a full operating day.

account.title: Personal Account
account.description: View your role permissions and update your display name or password.
account.name: Full Name
account.passwordReqs: Must be at least 8 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

system.title: System Information & Diagnostics
system.description: Verify backend API connectivity, database status, and deployed versions.
